production_gate.label: V2影子研究，不发布正式买点

source_basis: China coal market August 2026 price/inventory data
China Gold Association H1 2026 data and August SGE price evidence
GitHub main market/history and full_market_price_structure, reference trade date 2026-08-28

financial_data.limitation: no single repo-wide normalized-forward-financial dataset was found; valuation uses company-level H1 evidence and conservative normalization

broad_industry_scan.evidence: 1-7月计算机通信电子设备制造业利润+105.0%，收入+19.4%；H1电子信息制造业利润+96.9%，集成电路产量+23.1%。
1-7月有色矿采利润+74.9%、冶炼压延+91.8%；黄金8月价格重新上冲但H1国内原料金产量-14.62%，需按金/铜/铝等商品拆分。
1-7月煤炭开采利润+50.4%；8月动力煤价格上涨、港口库存下降，但焦煤受钢铁弱景气约束。
1-7月铁路船舶航空航天链保持正增长；H1造船完工+51.2%、新接订单+173.1%、手持订单+54.9%。
1-7月化学原料化学制品利润+56.6%、化纤+107.7%，但路线和价差Driver差异大，不可作为单一盈利链。
1-7月造纸纸制品利润+27.6%，收入+5.2%，但未找到足够强的8月领先变量升级为重点链。
油气开采利润+15.4%，炼化由亏转盈；上游油价Driver与炼化价差Driver必须分开。
1-7月汽车制造业利润-20.4%，不把局部零部件强势外推为整车行业改善。
收入+10.0%但利润-7.6%，量增未转化为利润改善。
农副食品-12.3%、酒饮茶-16.1%、家具-58.2%，未形成统一盈利改善主线。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: AI服务器/交换机高层高速板需求与产能利用率提升，产品结构升级推动ASP和毛利率
leading_variables: AI服务器与交换机出货/资本开支
高层高速板订单与稼动率
高频高速材料供给与价格
profit_chain_radar.note: 封装基板与CCL不并入本链；深南电路需剥离封装基板增量看PCB段。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: 先进封装/高算力芯片基板需求、稼动率与良率提升
leading_variables: 封装基板收入与毛利率
profit_chain_radar.exclusion_reason: 主板纯可比对象不足，不为满足数量硬拼不同封装/PCB机制公司。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: 电子布/铜箔/树脂成本与CCL提价传导形成的价差
profit_chain_radar.note: 8月电子布价格大涨既利好材料卖方又抬升CCL/PCB成本，因此继续拆、暂不形成统一当前机会。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: 实现黄金售价 × 矿产金销量 - 单位采选成本
profit_chain_radar.note: 黄金冶炼、珠宝零售不并入矿山链；中金黄金铜业务需单独作为辅助Driver。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: 自产煤售价与销量 - 单吨开采/运输成本
profit_chain_radar.note: 中国神华煤电运一体化使利润波动更低，不与纯煤矿公司机械横比；焦煤链单列且当前受钢铁压制。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: 焦煤价格/销量与钢焦需求
profit_chain_radar.exclusion_reason: 黑色冶炼利润-51.2%，下游盈利弱，暂不把煤炭大类改善外推至焦煤。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: 新船价格×交付量、订单结构、船台利用率与钢材/配套成本
profit_chain_radar.exclusion_reason: 订单景气极强，但公司整合/资产边界变化使当前Forward Bridge与估值可比性需复核，不制造精确价格区间。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: 长丝价格-PTA/MEG成本价差 × 销量/开工率
profit_chain_radar.exclusion_reason: 统计利润改善强，但本轮未获得足够新鲜且一致的8月价差/库存证据，维持观察不升级T2。

profit_chain_radar.direct_profit_driver: 不同产品路线差异过大
profit_chain_radar.exclusion_reason: 煤化工、氟化工、C2/C3、磷化工等不能用同一价差/成本变量解释，禁止合并成候选池。

comparison.exposure_note: 企业通讯/高端PCB暴露更直接
comparison.forward_bridge: AI服务器/交换机需求→高层高速板稼动率和产品结构→收入/毛利
comparison.reverse_evidence: 现金转换弱于利润增速；上游高频材料涨价；估值已高

comparison.cash_flow_note: 经营现金流15.02亿元，同比约+0.4%
comparison.exposure_note: PCB约55.9%收入，另有封装基板约24%，盈利Driver更分散
comparison.forward_bridge: AI需求→PCB+封装基板高负荷/良率→利润率提升
comparison.reverse_evidence: 应收/收入比上升；多业务使纯PCB可比性下降；估值更贵

company_comparisons.reason: 沪电收入/利润增速更快且PCB盈利暴露更纯，但现金流恶化削弱质量；两者当前价格均未进入安全区。

comparison.forward_bridge: 金/铜价格→实现售价+降本→矿山利润
comparison.reverse_evidence: 矿产金销量-4.05%；冶炼检修；金价高波动

comparison.forward_bridge: 金价→矿山毛利率，后续项目投产/复产决定量
comparison.reverse_evidence: 产量下降、现金流下降、杠杆更高

company_comparisons.reason: 中金黄金利润增速、杠杆和现金流边际更优；山东黄金更纯黄金Beta但产量与现金流反向证据更强。

comparison.forward_bridge: 自产煤售价/销量提升+供给约束→煤炭利润
comparison.reverse_evidence: 8月煤价上涨动能已有放缓迹象；周期利润需正常化

comparison.forward_bridge: 煤炭量价+煤电运一体化→稳定现金流
comparison.reverse_evidence: 并购导致可比口径变化；煤电一体化降低对煤价弹性

company_comparisons.reason: 若只看当前煤价改善的直接盈利弹性，陕西煤业更强；中国神华基本面稳定性更高但并非同等煤价Beta。

002463.earnings_basis: 2026E normalized EPS 3.2-3.4 based on H1 EPS 1.5191, strong Q2 growth, with cash-conversion haircut
002463.reasonable_price_assumption: 32-35x; high growth/ROE supports premium, but cash-flow decline and material-cost risk cap multiple
002463.uncertainty: AI capex durability, PCB mix, high-frequency material cost, cash conversion
002463.margin_of_safety_reason: growth-cycle and valuation sensitivity require ~18%-22% buffer versus reasonable range
002463.peer_sanity: 深南电路 growth is strong but even more expensive; peer check does not justify raising intrinsic value
falsifiers: AI/data-center PCB order growth materially slows
gross margin reverses as material costs cannot pass through
cash conversion stays materially below profit growth

002916.earnings_basis: 2026E normalized EPS 7.0-7.5 from H1 EPS 3.32 and Q2 acceleration, with receivables/multi-business uncertainty
002916.reasonable_price_assumption: 38-42x reflecting PCB+substrate growth and margin expansion but high valuation/working-capital risk
002916.uncertainty: substrate ramp/良率, AI demand, receivables, multi-segment mix
002916.margin_of_safety_reason: high multiple and ramp uncertainty require ~20%-25% buffer
002916.peer_sanity: profit growth supports premium, but current TTM valuation remains high
002916.action: 等待估值回落；结构强不等于低风险买点

600489.earnings_basis: normalized gold/copper price and normalized mining volume/cost, not current spot-price windfall
600489.reasonable_price_assumption: current gold price has risen sharply in August and H1 profits are price-led; stable cycle midpoint is too uncertain for a defensible narrow range
600489.uncertainty: gold price center, copper contribution, mine sales volume and smelter maintenance
600489.margin_of_safety_reason: commodity-price sensitivity is too high to convert current H1 earnings into a precise low-risk range
600489.action: 估值待复核；不因趋势强给正式买点
falsifiers: gold price falls back below normalized center

600547.earnings_basis: normalized gold price × recoverable mine volume less normalized unit cost; H1 current profit not directly capitalized
600547.reasonable_price_assumption: H1 mine production fell 22.7% while August gold price surged; too sensitive to price/volume normalization for a precise narrow range
600547.uncertainty: gold price, domestic mine restart/project ramp, leverage and cash flow
600547.margin_of_safety_reason: high gold beta plus production and leverage uncertainty requires explicit normalization first
600547.action: 估值待复核；趋势不替代价值
falsifiers: cash flow remains weak despite higher gold price

601225.earnings_basis: normalized EPS 2.1-2.4, below simple H1 annualization to remove part of coal-price windfall
601225.primary_method: normalized earnings × cycle-midpoint PE with dividend/asset sanity check
601225.reasonable_price_assumption: 10-12x normalized EPS; strong cash flow and low-cost resources support upper end but commodity cyclicality caps multiple
601225.uncertainty: thermal-coal price, production policy, long-term contract mix
601225.margin_of_safety_reason: coal price can mean-revert quickly; require ~18%-25% discount from midpoint/upper fair value

price_structure.note: mechanical structure file includes 601225 in right_candidate_codes; valuation still blocks low-risk entry

601225.action: 观察；等安全价格或盈利中枢上修证据
falsifiers: H2 earnings revert below normalized basis

601088.earnings_basis: normalized EPS 2.7-3.0 after avoiding direct capitalization of current coal-price uplift and allowing for integration stability
601088.primary_method: normalized earnings × 13-15x plus dividend/asset sanity check
601088.reasonable_price_assumption: integration, cash generation and dividend justify premium to pure coal beta; acquisition/comparability uncertainty limits upper multiple
601088.uncertainty: post-acquisition earnings base, coal price, power margin and payout
601088.margin_of_safety_reason: commodity plus M&A base uncertainty requires ~15%-20% buffer

price_structure.note: mechanical structure file includes 601088 in right_candidate_codes; not enough to override valuation

601088.action: 等待价格回归合理/安全区
falsifiers: acquired assets lift sustainable EPS materially above normalized base

600150.reason: asset/corporate integration and order-cycle accounting require rebuilt forward bridge before a reliable price range
